Method: 16,204 ids judged by DeepSeek Flash on name, company and blurb; a stricter pass ranked the shortlist; batches one and two were read once on 2026-11-02 by the WeChat id in the list, which Dajiala's post_history accepts in its ghid field and which finds renamed accounts the name cannot; an account was kept when it posted within 30 days, is not one production already reads or retired, and Flash judged its real titles to hold medical news. A row carries the account's current nickname, biz and newest article, so the collector's ordinary resolution reads it; wechat_id is the record of how it was found, never read at run time. group company is read every three days (read_every_days). Priority 1 stays with the regulators and societies of the earlier rounds: nothing here is read twice a day.
